_doc: NEWS-1 evaluation set for the AI use news_note: candidate model notes over constructed evidence lines (not recorded from any publisher; names of operators and assets are real, the items, figures, books and contracts are invented for the test). Each case records whether application.news_grounding.check_note must pass it or refuse it, and by which check. Scored by tests/evals/test_news_note_evals.py without a provider.
